status: Frozen before aggregate model results; engineering pilot, not product validation
tuning: No training or threshold tuning on this evaluation. Prior development of the separate JS formant tracker used Hillenbrand; that corpus is exploratory only.
contrast_data: 24 existing Wikimedia human recordings: 12 French u-y, 12 English i-ih; metadata word labels, NOT independently reviewed phonetic labels. 4 credited speakers. Report raw ranking and gated coverage separately.
learner_data: SpeechOcean762 official test split, 20 adults and 20 children selected by salted SHA256 order, two utterances per speaker. No local training. Not an assurance of absence from upstream pretraining.
learner_baseline: Greedy phoneme recognition, explicit ARPABET-to-IPA mapping, Levenshtein alignment. Sentence similarity versus corpus sentence accuracy; phone mismatch versus <=0.5 incorrect and >=1.5 acceptable labels, middle range excluded and counted. These are diagnostic baselines, not deployed scores.
uncertainty: 1000 speaker-cluster bootstrap replicates for sentence correlation; sample size limits all conclusions.
controls: same recordings with seeded 20 dB additive noise
